description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within the AttrEval-Simulation, showing five distinct categories represented by colored slices with corresponding percentage labels: ENTITYQUEST (26.0%, blue), HOTPOTQA (24.2%, red), POPQA (21.6%, yellow), TRIVIAQA (22.7%, orange), and WEBQUESTIO (3.6%, teal). The slices are arranged in a clockwise descending order of size, starting from the top right with ENTITYQUEST, followed by HOTPOTQA, POPQA, TRIVIAQA, and finally WEBQUESTIO at the top left. Each category is labeled with its name and percentage value connected by a thin line to its respective slice, and there is no legend or exploded slices; the chart uses distinct colors to differentiate the sources.
